mentions.name: Abracadanames
mentions.description: A website for discovering first names through an interactive full-screen wall UI with infinite browsing, keeping most screen space on the core content. A name sampling algorithm makes browsing enjoyable, with gender selection as the only default filter. The search field supports natural-language queries via a local multilingual interpretation engine with a cloud LLM fallback, backed by a custom database engine built in Rust and compiled to WASM for performance on Cloudflare Workers, without an external database service.
mentions.problem: Existing first-name websites frustrated the author's family member; they feel cluttered and not smooth to use, almost like a one-to-one translation of the underlying database queries, requiring upfront filters and sorting with paginated results.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a website for discovering first names that’s enjoyable to explore: https://abracadanames.com
mentions.author: PopFlamingo
